doc_title: Revised penalties under the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Source: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, via Vikaspedia)
note: Transcribed row by row from mv_amendment_2019_penalties.pdf (OCR + checked against page images). 'amend_section' is the clause of the Amendment Act as printed in the table. 'mva_section' is the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 section the clause amends; it is filled only where confirmed by an independent source, otherwise null.

rows.offence: Motor vehicle used by a juvenile (minor)
rows.penalty: Vehicle registration may be cancelled for a year. After one year, a fresh application for registration is allowed to be submitted.

rows.offence: General penalty for offences where no penalty is specifically provided for
rows.penalty: First offence - Rs. 500; second/subsequent offence - Rs. 1500.
Penalty of Rs. 1000.
Penalty of Rs. 500.

rows.offence: Disobedience of orders of authorities and refusal to give information
rows.penalty: Penalty of Rs. 2000.

rows.offence: Unauthorized use of vehicles without licence
rows.penalty: Penalty of Rs. 5000.
Penalty of Rs. 5000.
Penalty of Rs. 10,000.
Rs. 1000 - Rs. 2000 for light motor vehicle; Rs. 2000 - Rs. 4000 for medium passenger or goods vehicles, and impounding of driving licence for second/subsequent offence.
Imprisonment of 6 months - 1 year and/or fine of Rs. 1000 - Rs. 5000 for first offence; imprisonment up to 2 years and/or fine up to Rs. 10,000 for second offence.
Imprisonment up to 6 months and/or fine up to Rs. 10,000 for first offence; imprisonment up to 2 years and/or fine of Rs. 15,000 for second offence.

rows.offence: Driving when mentally or physically unfit to drive
rows.penalty: First offence - up to Rs. 1000; second/subsequent offence - up to Rs. 2000.
Imprisonment of up to 6 months and/or fine up to Rs. 5000 for first offence; imprisonment up to 1 year and/or fine up to Rs. 10,000 for second offence.
Imprisonment of up to 1 month and/or fine up to Rs. 500 for first offence; imprisonment up to 1 month and/or fine up to Rs. 10,000 for second offence.
Imprisonment of up to 6 months and/or fine up to Rs. 10,000 for first offence; imprisonment up to 1 year and/or fine up to Rs. 10,000 for second offence.

rows.offence: Driving a motor vehicle without wearing a safety belt (seat belt), or carrying passengers not wearing seat belts
rows.penalty: Fine of Rs. 1000.

rows.offence: Driving a motor vehicle with a child under fourteen years of age who is not secured by a safety belt or a child restraint system
rows.penalty: Fine of Rs. 1000.

rows.offence: Violation of safety measures for motor cycle drivers and pillion riders, refusal to stop and submit vehicle for weighing, use of phones in silent zones and failure to allow free passage to emergency vehicles
rows.penalty: Fine of Rs. 1000 and disqualified for holding licence for a period of three months.

rows.offence: Failing to draw to the side of the road on the approach of a fire service vehicle, an ambulance or other emergency vehicle specified by the State Government
rows.penalty: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or a fine of ten thousand rupees (Rs. 10,000), or both.

rows.offence: Sounding the horn needlessly, continuously or more than necessary to ensure safety; sounding the horn in an area with a traffic sign prohibiting the horn (silence zone); or driving a vehicle using a cut-out that releases exhaust gases other than through the silencer
rows.penalty: Fine of Rs. 1000; for a second or subsequent offence, fine of Rs. 2000.
Fine of Rs. 2000 and/or imprisonment up to 3 months for the first offence; fine of Rs. 4000 and/or imprisonment up to 3 months for the second offence.

Fine of Rs. 25,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years and cancellation of registration of the motor vehicle for 12 months; the juvenile becomes ineligible to obtain a learner's licence until the age of 25 years.

rows.offence: Causing obstruction to free flow of traffic
rows.penalty: Fine of Rs. 500.

rows.offence: Overloading of two-wheelers (more than two people / triple riding)
rows.penalty: Rs. 2000 and disqualification of licence for 3 months.
Rs. 1000 and disqualification of licence for 3 months.
